T2|p.fact: EBA's datapoint for Template 2 column p (K_42.00.b c0160) is metric pi977 'Percentage of exposures estimated'. EBA Q&A 2022_6625 states what it is a percentage of: the exposures without an EPC label (column o) for which the institution provides EP estimates, so that column a = columns b-g + o × (1 − p). The platform computes it so and the file carries it as a ratio (0.4 = 40%). ITS 2024/3172 Annex XL keeps the 2022/2453 wording of columns o and p and of the Template 2 instructions the Q&A answers.

qa.answer: Column P reports the percentage of the exposures without EPC label of the collateral for which the institution is providing EP estimates.
qa.also: Column A in Template 2 of Annex 1 to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/2453 should be the sum of: - columns from H to N + O OR - columns from B to G + (O * (1 - P))

qa.answer: All these validation rules have been reviewed and deactivated under the new validation rules release (as of 22 March 2024), uploaded to the Reporting framework 3.4.

qa.answer: The disclosed amount shall be the nominal value related to the latest reference date for which the institution computed the chosen alignment metric, in line with how this is defined also in the EBA`s DPM under Reporting Framework 3.3. This value of the alignment metric disclosed shall be updated and recalculated on an annual basis.

qa.answer: This implies that institutions shall update their targets with the same frequency as the values updated in columns (d) and (e), therefore on an annual basis as specified in the previous paragraph of this Q&A.
